versions.vite: 6.4.4 (installed with legacy-peer-deps: the plugin's peer range stops at 5.x)

hints.voice: python3 {S}/mc.py setup --project .   (copies {SKILL}/assets/template to source/ and runs npm ci; skips what is done)  then  python3 {S}/voice.py --project . --emit source/src/timing.ts
hints.visuals: Write the film in source/src/scenes/ (data.ts, film.tsx, one chNN-*.tsx per chapter; reuse source/src/kit, key every beat to a line id with waitUntilLine/waitUntilCue). Then python3 {S}/mc.py stills --project .  (typecheck + build + one still per line into stills/, overview build/stills-sheet.jpg; it lists any [timing] late warnings). Read the sheet and every still, fix, repeat; check text size and contrast with python3 {S}/legibility.py --project . (fix every red box in stills/legibility/, re-render, re-run); then python3 {S}/vstate.py attest visuals "<what you checked and fixed>"
hints.render: python3 {S}/mc.py bench --project .   (prints fps and the ETA)  then  python3 {S}/mc.py render --project . --max-minutes 100   (segmented and resumable; exit code 3 means the budget ran out: run the same command again; run it in the background with a log if the ETA is over 2 minutes)
